people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
translations.bsb: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.
translations.kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted
translations.asv: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.
